2026 DUTCH GRAND PRIX 
21 - 23 August 2026 
  
 
From :  The FIA Formula 1 Technical Delegate  
To :  The Stewards Date :  22 August 2026 
  
 
TECHNICAL DELEGATE’S REPORT 
 
 
The following driver is using a new internal combustion engine (ICE) for the remainder of the 
Competition: 
 
Number Car Driver Previously used ICE 
    
27 Audi Nico Hülkenber g 3 
 
The internal combustion engine used by Nico Hülkenberg is one (1) of the four (4) new internal 
combustion engines allowed for the 2026 Championship season and this is in conformity with 
B8.2.2 a) of the 2026 Formula One Sporting Regulations. 
 
 
The following driver is using a new turbocharger (TC) for the remainder of the Competition: 
 
Number Car Driver Previously used TC 
    
27 Audi Nico Hülkenber g 3 
 
The turbocharger used by Nico Hülkenberg is one (1) of the four (4) new turbochargers allowed 
for the 2026 Champions
